name: Fruit Slot
description: A fruit machine that tells the time: glossy fruit on every reel above red digits, chrome and blue lacquer, LED readouts and a glowing SPIN button; the reels spin and land on the current time.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1
